description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) ISystemTime within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface provides methods to check system time availability and retrieve timezone offset, along with an enum for timezone accuracy levels.

classes.name: ISystemTime
classes.description: An interface for system time operations, including checking availability and obtaining timezone offset with accuracy levels.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the system time is available.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset in seconds, with an accuracy level.
